purpose: Source of truth for project proof, review sources, warranty terms, and repair cost evidence used in SEO, GEO, Maps, SXO, schema, and AI-citation work.

policy.verifiedMeans: Owner-supplied evidence, public profile source, invoice/estimate data, permit record, or original project media has been inspected and recorded.
policy.publishRule: Only records with evidence_status = verified may be used as proof claims in public copy, schema, captions, case studies, or project cards.
policy.photoRule: Use original project photos only for proof-bearing project modules. Stock imagery may be used only for neutral decorative or educational assets, never as evidence.
policy.privacyRule: Do not store customer names, private addresses, phone numbers, emails, permit numbers, or unredacted documents in this ledger.
